name: Windhoek
tagline: Highland capital and gateway to Namibia's wild
summary: Windhoek is Namibia's small, orderly capital, where most road trips to Etosha and the desert begin. See the Christuskirche and Independence Memorial Museum, eat game meat at Joe's Beerhouse, try kapana grilled beef in Katutura and walk among zebra at Daan Viljoen.
seasonNote: Dry winter (May to October) is ideal; summer brings afternoon storms.
arrival: Hosea Kutako International is 45 minutes east of the city.
gettingAround: Taxis in town; hire a 4x4 for the country.
cashTip: The Namibian dollar is pegged 1:1 to the rand, and rand is accepted. Fill up with fuel and cash in towns; lodges take cards.
foodTip: Game meat, kapana and German-style bakeries.
buyTip: Crafts, Swakara wool and Namibian gemstones.
